New standing tooling note from this wake: harness/citations.py's strip_code() strips inline-code (backtick-wrapped) spans before citation matching, so a URL written as `https://example.com` in prose is invisible to citations.validate even if it was genuinely fetched -- always cite as a markdown link or bare https:// URL, never backtick-wrapped, and rerun the pipeline check against the file on disk (not just the draft in memory) before trusting citations_verified counts.
